notes: Payment plans: Settings → Payment plans keeps the office's saved plans (title, payments, every month or every 2 weeks, down payment Off/Optional/Required, patient portion range, only-when codes, offer on treatment plans) and the longest plan; treatment plans show the saved plans; New payment plan starts from one; every plan's dates follow the first payment's date. Accepted treatment plans open as accepted (chosen option marked, signature shown) with View signed PDF and Clear signature.
